articleTitle: Anomaly Detection for Bolt Tightening in Automotive Engine Assembly Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the advancement of industrial automation, the quality requirements for automotive engine assembly bolt tightening have become increasingly stringent, as they are directly related to engine performance and vehicle safety. Traditional monitoring methods for bolt tightening rely on preset torque criteria, which often overlook anomalies such as material defects and tool wear. To address the issue of limited negative samples in industrial data, this study proposes an innovative positive sample boundary modelling strategy based on artificial intelligence, combined with a random forest algorithm for anomaly detection. By transforming time-series data into high-dimensional feature data, an efficient classifier is constructed through the integration of multiple decision trees. Experimental results from real engine assembly line data demonstrate that the proposed method can quickly and accurately identify abnormal conditions without increasing computational burden, significantly improving assembly quality and reducing failure rates.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact Calculation of Penetrators on Typical Metal Protective Structures Based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To enhance the efficiency of impact calculations for penetrators on targets, a typical metal protective structure vulnerability model was introduced, alongside models for penetrator potency, target intersection, and the calculation of functional failure probabilities for typical metal protective structure. A system for calculating functional failures of typical metal protective structure based on the Unity3D engine was developed. This system enables the input of penetrator parameters, potency calculations, and the assessment of the penetrator's damage effects on typical metal protective structure. The comprehensive system design supports the development of penetrators and provides a basis for calculating functional failures of typical metal protective structure and for upgrading metal protective structures protection strategies.

articleTitle: Reasonable Spacing Optimization of New Overlapping Tunnels Under Existing Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the advancement of urbanization, underground space resources are becoming increasingly tense, and the excavation of overlapping tunnels under existing tunnels has become the norm. The determination of the optimal spacing of new overlapping tunnels under existing tunnels has become a key problem in the planning of crossing tunnels. Based on the finite element analysis software ABAQUS, this paper uses Python language to carry out parametric design of different spacing of new overlapping tunnels under existing tunnels. The penalty function and Neider—Mead algorithm are used to optimize the analysis. The surface settlement, the convergence of the existing tunnel roof and floor, the maximum bending moment and the bearing force of the lining are taken as the optimization target values. The parametric model is calculated and the optimal spacing is proposed. The research method has certain reference significance for similar projects.

articleTitle: Real-Time License Plate Positioning Algorithm Optimization and Hardware Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of limited application environment and high consumption of hardware resources of the number plate positioning system implemented by the traditional edge detection algorithm, an improved Canny edge detection algorithm is proposed in this paper. The algorithm uses Cordic IP cores to optimise the Sobel operator to compute gradient magnitude and direction, replacing complex operations and reducing hardware costs. The introduction of the Otsu algorithm allows the system to select appropriate thresholds for different environments. The improved and optimised algorithm is implemented on FPGA and simulated to locate 2260 number plates in different environments with a positioning accuracy of 99.58%, an average time consumption of 2.43 ms and a hardware resource consumption of less than 67%. The experimental results show that the system can be applied to a variety of complex environments, providing a feasible technical solution for automatic licence plate recognition system.

articleTitle: Research on the Implementation Path of Data Assetization in Electric Power Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Under the background of the state actively promoting data assetization, this study proposes a four-stage evolution path of “data resourceization-resource productization-product assetization-asset valorization” by analyzing the concepts of data assets and data assetization. By systematically sorting out the status quo and problems of data assetization in electric power enterprises, this study proposes the implementation path of electric power data assets from identification, quality and value assessment to operation and management based on the principle of implementable on the ground, so as to guide enterprises to manage data assets in a comprehensive manner and realize the value creation of assetization in a step-by-step manner.

articleTitle: The Design of HTTP Protocol Parser Based on Parallelization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: At present, more and more network applications require deep parsing of data packets. That is, not only identifying the protocol of the packet, but also extracting more useful information, such as the URL, the cookie of the HTTP message. Aiming at the above problems, this paper designs an HTTP protocol parser based on multi-core platform. The main function of the parser is to identify the request packet and response packet in the HTTP access data stream, as well as the response packet matched by each request packet, and can output some data fields of interest for the application.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of 3D Camera Calculation Results
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The 2024 version of the C-NCAP regulations has added a Farside test condition. To accurately obtain the head trajectory of the dummy during the collision experiment, this paper conducted an experiment on a certain vehicle model and used camera analysis software to study the effects of lens calibration parameters, different camera positions, and different focal lengths on the calculation results. The analysis results indicate that lens calibration can significantly improve the accuracy of calculation results; The camera calculation accuracy for the initial position of the dummy's head is highest when tilted; The lens with a focal length of 11.5mm has high and stable calculation accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Information Fusion Target Recognition Algorithm for Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Due to the varying scale and diversity of target objects in complex scenes, multi-target recognition systems are prone to encountering issues such as false detection and low accuracy. In response to these challenges, we improve and optimize the multi-target recognition model from the perspective of multi-scale information fusion and propose RBs-YOLOv8. Based on the YOLOv8 framework, this model combines the RepViT framework for feature extraction and optimizes the cross-scale connection in feature fusion. At the same time, the BiFPN module is used for weighted fusion. For the fusion of varying channel information, we also propose an attention mechanism to enhance the model's capacity for learning global features. It embeds it into the splicing process of features of various scales. Through training and verification on data sets in real scenes, experimental results show that compared with the traditional YOLOv8 model, the average accuracy of the improved RBs-YOLOv8 model is improved by 17 percentage points, and the loss function decreases faster and smoother during training. Additionally, To determine how each improvement contributes to the model's ability to learn global features, we conduct a series of ablation experiments. Demonstrating the efficacy and proving its effectiveness, the experiment results showcase the proposed multi-target recognition algorithm.

articleTitle: Failure Diagnosis Method of Oil Pump Well Based on MobileNet V3
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Aiming at the fault diagnosis problem of indicator diagram of pumping Wells, a lightweight convolutional neural network is proposed, and the attention mechanism is replaced to improve the network diagnostic performance under the condition of reducing the number of parameters and calculation. MobileNet-V3 was used as the network infrastructure, and the SE Attention Module in the inverted residual module of MobileNet-V3 was replaced by the Efficient Channel Attention Module. In the inverted residual module, ECA multiplied the generated channel attention recalification weight with the input feature map from the channel dimension, and finally obtained the feature map with attention weighting. Based on the proposed method, the complexity of the network model structure is reduced under the premise of ensuring the accuracy of the model diagnosis. The experimental results show that the diagnosis accuracy of the improved MobileNet-V3 reaches 89.20%, which meets the actual production needs of oil fields.

articleTitle: The Real-Time Monitoring and Control of Intelligent Sensor Networks in Electrical Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to understand the real-time monitoring and control of intelligent sensor networks in electrical automation, a research based on intelligent sensor networks for real-time monitoring and control in electrical automation has been proposed. This paper first utilizes the intelligent sensor nodes of the intelligent sensor network in the system data layer to collect signal data of building electrical equipment, enabling the central node to gather and integrate the collected data. Secondly, the Zigbee intelligent network at the communication layer is used to aggregate the data integrated by the central node into an internal gateway, which uploads the data to the application foundation platform at the application layer. Finally, the experimental results indicate that setting the number of cluster heads in the intelligent sensing network to 25 can achieve an ideal network node lifespan; This system can accurately diagnose the type of fault, identify the location of the fault, and effectively save energy consumption of building electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of the Number of Joints on the Stability of Rock Mass
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Rock mass in nature often has joints, and many geotechnical projects need to be carried out in cracked rock masses. The presence of joints in rock mass has an significant consequence on the stability of geotechnical engineering. Based on the finite element analysis software ABAQUS, this paper uses Python language for secondary development to establish a parametric finite element model with different number of joints. The influence of joint number on rock stability is studied. The resultant indicates that in the course of rock failure, the fissure first starts from the joint tip, and the propagation route of crack is usually along the stress and the maximum principal plastic strain concentration zone. With the upsurge of the magnitude of joints, the rock trauma is more severe. The research outcome supply a conferment for the safety construction of geotechnical engineering.

articleTitle: Multimodal Fusion Indoor Positioning Method for Smartphones
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The capacity of smartphones to provide high-precision indoor positioning is an increasingly important application of these devices. Nevertheless, in complex indoor environments, it is challenging to achieve high-precision real-time mobile phone positioning through the use of a single sensor. This paper presents an analysis of the error sources and performance bottlenecks associated with smartphone indoor positioning and outlines the design of a multimodal fusion positioning method. Firstly, initial coarse positioning of the mobile phone is determined at the base station by estimating the angle of arrival (AOA) of the Bluetooth signal broadcast by the mobile phone. Secondly, in the region of coarse positioning, the time difference of arrival (TDOA) of the acoustic signals transmitted from the base station to the mobile phone is combined based on an improved indoor signal propagation model and a geometric dilution of precision (GDOP) factor. Finally, the optimal TDOA set is selected, and the weights of the two sensors are adjusted by updating the GDOP value of the device's current position in real time. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed multimodal fusion method enhances the efficiency of position computation by 18.7% in comparison to the single-sensor positioning method.

articleTitle: Modelling of the Birth-Reversal Process Based on the SAE Stack Self-Coding Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Wastewater treatment plant as a key link in the chain of water environmental protection, its safe and stable operation is a prerequisite to ensure the quality of the effluent. In the wastewater treatment process, the quality of the biological reaction process directly determines the quality of the effluent water quality, the process of many predictable indicators, which reflect important information about the wastewater treatment process, but most of them are difficult to measure or not easy to measure, the maintenance cost of high response time delay, usually not suitable for real-time monitoring. In order to handle the online real-time acquisition of these variables, soft measurement techniques provide a feasible and effective solution, and the modelling of data-driven soft measurement techniques for municipal wastewater treatment plants is reviewed and discussed. A deep neural network soft measurement model (SAE, Stacked Auto-encoder) is proposed. Shallow neural networks tend to perform poorly in the face of complex industrial conditions such as wastewater treatment, so deep learning neural networks with multi-layer structures stand out as a more popular solution. The intermediate process of wastewater treatment has a lot of data that need to be measured, so the soft measurement modelling for wastewater treatment is of great industrial importance. Facing this situation, this paper constructs a deep learning model: stack self-coding, on the basis of which it is adjusted and changed to a deep neural network soft measurement model more suitable for wastewater treatment. Finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by a simulation platform case study.

articleTitle: Improved Compact Convolutional Transformers: The Faster Convergence Resource-Efficient Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Despite the excellent performance of Transformer-based architectures, they also suffer from the drawback of high computational resource consumption. To address this issue, Compact Convolutional Transformers(CCT) have achieved strong competitiveness on small image datasets with fewer parameters through appropriate sizing adjustments and convolutional tokenization. Based on this, this paper further proposes Improved Compact Convolutional Transformers(ICCT). These models have achieved a comprehensive improvement in accuracy compared to CCT by modifying their positional encoding and feed-forward neural network, while keeping all other components, parmeters, and hyperparameters unchanged.

articleTitle: Image Recognition of Rice Growth Period Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the field of crop image detection, traditional detection methods for the growth period of related crops rely heavily on humans, resulting in relatively low accuracy. At present, the mainstream spectral detection technology based on remote sensing images of crops has high hardware requirements for image acquisition and a complex system. In order to realize a crop growth period image detection method with high accuracy, convenient operation, and fast speed. A crop convolutional neural network (Crop-Net) is proposed to train and test rice images at different growth stages. Experimental results show that the proposed detection algorithm has higher detection accuracy in the detection task of ten growth periods of rice.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy Trading Mechanism Design for Electricity-Hydrogen Hybrid Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a mechanism for multi-energy trading in electricity-hydrogen hybrid charging stations (EHCSs), which is suitable for both electric vehicles (EVs) and hydrogen vehicles (HVs). Unlike previous research focusing on energy allocation at the system level, this study emphasizes vehicle-level energy trading. The proposed mechanism includes an EHCS aggregator that functions as an auctioneer, managing energy transactions with EVs and HVs. EHCSs can bidirectionally trade electricity with EVs but only sell hydrogen to HVs. Vehicles submit strategic energy trading bids to maximize their individual utilities. Based on these bids, the EHCS aggregator allocates electricity and hydrogen to vehicles to optimize social welfare. Following this allocation, EVs and HVs buy or sell corresponding energy and make payments according to a designed pricing rule. The Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction mechanism is employed to price both electricity and hydrogen. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and validate its key properties.

articleTitle: Airport Gate Allocation Using the Distributed Sub-population Enhanced Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In this study, we introduce the Distributed Sub-population Enhanced Differential Evolution (DSEDE), an extension of the Success-History based Adaptive Differential Evolution (SHADE) algorithm. The DSEDE algorithm segments the population into sub-populations that evolve autonomously and share information generation ally. Applied to the aircraft gate assignment problem (GAP), involving three sub-fitness functions, a total fitness function, and six constraints, DSEDE outperforms both DE and SHADE in computational experiments, showcasing its strength in multi-objective optimization with complex constraints. This research contributes a dynamic algorithmic framework to evolutionary computation.

articleTitle: Research of LT Code Degree Distribution Based on Joint Degree Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In view of the fact that the performance of the current fountain code distribution is degraded under the condition of short code length, a new binary-sliding robust soliton distribution is formed by combining the binary system distribution and the sliding robust soliton degree distribution, and the scale coefficient is introduced to make the joint degree distribution achieve better results. The simulation results show that in the case of short code length, the decoding performance is improved relative to these two degree distributions when the union degree distribution is used to encode LT codes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Meeting Summarization Models via Large Language Model Data Generation and Weighted Sampling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Meeting summaries improve team communication and decision-making efficiency by extracting key information and decisions. However, due to the complexity of organizing meeting records and the need to protect the privacy of participants, available datasets are often very scarce, which restricts the development and application of meeting summary technology. Existing data augmentation techniques usually expand the data set by transforming or reconstructing the existing data samples to improve the generalization ability of the model. This leads to a model that does not generalize well when faced with unseen data. Therefore, this paper proposes a data augmentation method for meeting summaries based on large language models, which is implemented by sequential expansion method and weight sampling strategy. First, considering that the length of text data generated by large language models cannot meet the requirements of meeting datasets, we propose a novel sequential expansion method to increase the length of generated meeting data and ensure the consistency of its context. Secondly, due to the imbalanced influence of the original dataset and the generated dataset during model training, we use a weighted sampling strategy to balance them and ensure that both can achieve stable learning. Experiments on the AMI dataset show that the performance of meeting summarization is significantly improved by applying this method to the current best pre-trained meeting summary model DIALOGLED-large.

articleTitle: Research on Internet of Things Signals Acquisition and Processing based on Edge Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has led to the generation of vast quantities of data, placing considerable strain on conventional cloud computing infrastructure. Edge computing has emerged as a viable solution to address this challenge. In this study, we propose an Internet of Things (IoT) signal processing framework that is combined with distributed edge nodes. The objective is to improve data transmission efficiency and real-time performance. Firstly, in consideration of the constrained resources of edge devices, we have devised lightweight preprocessing algorithms, including frequency domain filtering based on Fourier transform and a denoising algorithm based on wavelet transform, with the objective of reducing the noise and redundant information present in the original signal. Subsequently, the adaptive compressed sensing technology was employed to compress the preprocessed signal, which resulted in a notable reduction in the bandwidth requirement for data transmission. Subsequently, in order to fully utilise the computing capabilities of edge nodes, we introduce a multi-task learning collaborative computing model. The model permits the sharing of computing tasks between multiple edge nodes, facilitates data collaboration between edge nodes through federated learning, and reduces computing redundancy and communication overhead. The experimental phase employs the Google Edge TPU Dataset to evaluate the dataset pertinent to the Internet of Things. The results indicate that the proposed methodology exhibits a notable enhancement in data processing latency and transmission efficacy in comparison to the conventional approach.

articleTitle: Small-Object Detection Based on ITS-YOLOv5s-P2
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In small object detection tasks, the instances of small objects are numerous, multi-scale, densely distributed, and easily occluded between objects, often resulting in missed and false detections, making it difficult to improve detection accuracy. A new small object detection algorithm called ITS-YOLOv5s-P2 is proposed to address these issues. Firstly, a P2 detection layer is added to YOLOv5s, introducing high-resolution feature maps and rich detail information to improve the overall recognition performance of the model. Secondly, an improved adaptive anchor box strategy (IAAS) is proposed, allowing the model to learn better and fit the real bounding boxes, which is beneficial for multi-scale object recognition. Then, a tiny object detection layer (TODL) is designed, incorporating texture information from shallow regions of the backbone network into the prediction head, enhancing the model's ability to perceive details of small objects. Finally, Soft-NMS is used instead of NMS for non-maximum suppression, effectively mitigating the issue of object occlusion that leads to missed detections caused by the aggressive filtering of traditional NMS. Experiments show that the ITS-YOLOv5s-P2 algorithm effectively improves the detection accuracy of small objects. On the public dataset VisDrone2019, the parameters and the number of floating-point operations of this algorithm increase by only 0.2M and 7.3G compared to YOLOv5s, while mAP@O.5 and mAP@[.5:.95] increase by 11.6% and 9.1%.

articleTitle: A Robust Multi-AGV Cooperative Path Planning Method Considering Spatiotemporal Distance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the widespread application of Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) in warehousing and logistics systems, the optimization of multi-AGV path planning has become a critical issue. Current methods primarily focus on minimizing operating time and energy consumption but often overlook spatiotemporal distances between paths, leading to frequent path conflicts and interferences in the system. This paper proposes a neural network based time window estimation model, designed to generate time windows that better align with dynamic environments. Based on this model, we introduce a collaborative multi-AGV path planning method that optimizes spatiotemporal distances between paths. Compared to the Conflict-Based Search (CBS) method, this approach significantly improves the spatiotemporal distance between AGVs during task execution, enhancing the robustness of AGV clusters while only marginally increasing time costs.

articleTitle: CassavaViM: MambaVision with Efficient Multi-Scale Attention for Cassava Leaf Disease Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Cassava leaf diseases represent a critical challenge to crop yield and quality. Despite the growing need for accurate disease identification, existing solutions often fail to adequately capture the subtle and diverse symptoms of these diseases. To address this gap, we propose Cassava ViM, a novel model for cassava leaf disease recognition that builds upon the Mamba Vision architecture. Cassava ViM leverages a multi-scale fusion strategy and integrates an Efficient Multi-Scale Attention (EMA) module with Cross-Spatial Learning, enabling it to effectively capture disease patterns across varying scales while refining feature integration. Through comprehensive experiments on the Cassava Leaf Diseases Dataset, Cassava ViM achieves a remarkable accuracy of 87.590/0, showing a substantial improvement over known state-of-the-art methods. This technology enhances cassava's early disease detection capabilities, facilitating timely intervention and improving agricultural productivity in southern regions such as the Greater Bay Area.

articleTitle: DDA-NG: Fusing Non-negative Matrix Factorization and Graph Tranformer to Enhance Potential Dmg-Disease Associations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Predicting drug-disease relationships is crucial in the biomedical field, but traditional laboratory experiments are time-consuming and costly, often lacking predictive accuracy and efficiency. This paper presents the DDA-NG model, which integrates Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and Graph Transformer (GT) to predict drug-disease associations. The model utilizes NMF to extract features from drugs and diseases, capturing global structural information. It then integrates various similarity data and captures higher-order structural relationships through the Graph Transformer. By fusing features from both modules, DDA-NG enhances feature diversity and prediction accuracy. Experimental results show significant performance improvements across multiple datasets, demonstrating its strong capability to identify potential drugs for diseases.

articleTitle: Combining Transfer Learning and GAN for GPR Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Using transfer learning to address the issue of the difficulties of obtaining real samples for Ground penetrating radar (GPR) involves a significant challenge: finding an appropriate pre-training dataset. Current approaches either overlook the significance of dataset similarity or have numerous drawbacks when gathering pre-training datasets. To overcome this issue, a GAN (Generative Adversarial Network)-based transfer learning approach is proposed. The method uses GAN to produce a simulated dataset that is very comparable to genuine GPR data, effectively overcoming the difficulty of acquiring pre-training datasets. Following that, a two-stage migration learning method is utilized to transfer the shared parameters learned from the simulated GPR data to the actual GPR dataset. The accuracy of target recognition was further increased by incorporating a residual convolutional neural network into the feature extraction network. Furthermore, to thoroughly investigate the extent to which dataset similarity influences the impact of transfer learning, the study built a similarity comparison model and confirmed the efficacy and caliber of the simulated GPR dataset. The technique of combining GAN and transfer learning is demonstrated through comparison studies to successfully raise the small-sample GPR target recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Layer-by-layer 3D Reconstruction of Porous Media Based on Cascade Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) images play an important role in the field of digital coring, and the accurate acquisition of 3D images is important for the study of the relevant media structure. Reconstruction of 3D structures from single or multiple two-dimensional (2D) images using computer mathematical modelling methods is currently the main way to obtain 3D structures of research media. The rapid development of deep learning has facilitated the development of 3D reconstruction methods based on generative adversarial networks(GAN). However, this method requires a large number of training samples and can only reconstruct samples with small sizes. In this paper, we propose a cascade conditional generative adversarial network (CCGAN) model based on 2D inter-layer correlation. The model adopts 2D layer-by-layer reconstruction to construct 3D structures, characterises the interlayer variation of 3D structures through joint multi-layer 2D difference images, and learns 3D interlayer correlation using deep learning ideas, which can effectively improve the size and morphological quality of the generated samples. A number of tests have been carried out on isotropic porous media, and the visual inspection and quantitative analysis show that the reconstruction results have good accuracy and diversity, and are in good agreement with the target results.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Network Based Ear- Electroencephalograph Identity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Biometrics are widely used in the field of information security. Compared with other biometric technologies (such as fingerprint and iris recognition), electroencephalograph (EEG) rely on their high degree of individual specificity and are difficult to forge. EEG have gradually become a focus of identification research. However, the existing EEG recognition technology still faces problems such as complex equipment and inconvenient operation in its practical application. In particular, there are significant shortcomings in terms of portability and utility. To solve these problems, this paper innovatively proposes a multi-scale convolutional neural network based on a single-channel portable ear-EEG device. Combining existing feature extraction algorithms, computing multi-dimensional features of single-channel EEG to ultimately optimize classification performance. The experiment invited 14 subjects to participate in the identification test, and the results showed that the model achieved an average classification accuracy of 86.48%• The experimental results verify the effectiveness of ear EEG in identity recognition applications. Expanding the Application Prospects of Ear-Electroencephalography Identity Recognition Technology.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of Firefighting Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Based on VMD-KAN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This study introduces an integrated model combining VMD, KAN, and LSTM for fault prediction in firefighting drones during critical operations. VMD extracts multi-scale features, KAN captures nonlinear characteristics, and LSTM analyzes time series data to predict faults. The model shows higher accuracy and generalization than traditional methods, providing a novel health management solution for firefighting drones.

articleTitle: Image Denoising Method Based on Channel Compression and Split-Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the image restoration task, how to make full use of spatial and channel feature information to improve the reconstruction quality of the model without significantly increasing the computational complexity is an important research issue. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a CS module (Channel Compression and Split-Attention) specifically for optimizing image denoising tasks. The module first compresses the features through a preliminary convolution operation, then introduces the split attention convolution mechanism to split the features by channel and dynamically weight them, thereby enhancing the model's adaptive attention to different feature channels and improving feature expression capabilities. Through experiments on multiple image denoising datasets, the results show that the CS module significantly improves the image reconstruction quality, especially in terms of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR). At the same time, the introduction of the CS module does not lead to a significant increase in computational complexity, maintaining a high computational efficiency, which verifies the practicality and superiority of the module in image denoising tasks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Personal Smart Home System Based on Edge Computing Gate
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the advancements in IoT technology, cloud computing, and big data technology, smart living has become an integral part of people's lives. However, traditional intelligent data computing relies heavily on cloud services, which often suffer from issues such as slow response times and high energy consumption. To address these issues, this study introduces an edge computing architecture centered on gateways, serving as an intermediate layer between user devices and cloud servers. This architecture enables high-speed data processing, low-latency responses, and rapid end-to-end connections, making it suitable for most small-scale and personal smart home systems.

articleTitle: A Container Cloud Elastic Scaling Method Based on GRU Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In modern container cloud computing environments, achieving efficient elastic scaling is crucial to optimizing resource utilization and improving system performance. This paper proposes a new prediction model based on gated recurrent unit (GRU) and attention mechanism for load prediction and elastic scaling strategy optimization. The model uses the time series processing capability of GRU combined with the optimization characteristics of the attention mechanism to improve the accuracy and real-time performance of load prediction. Experimental results show that compared with traditional methods, the model can more accurately capture the load change trend and achieve more agile and efficient resource scheduling and management, thereby effectively reducing resource waste and improving service quality. This study provides a novel and effective solution for elastic scaling in container cloud environments.

articleTitle: FedAcc Algorithm Based on Client Accuracy in Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the FedAvg (Federated Averaging) algorithm of Federated Learning, the server primarily updates parameters by performing a weighted average of local model parameters based on the size of the client datasets, giving more weight to clients with larger datasets. In practical applications, clients with larger datasets do not necessarily contribute the most to the model. To address this issue, this paper designs a FedAcc (Federated Averaging with Accuracy-based Weighting) algorithm based on client accuracy and conducts experimental comparisons to analyze the performance of FedAcc and FedAvg. In the experiments, four different types of datasets were selected: image datasets MNIST and CIFAR-10, text dataset IMDB, and regression task dataset California Housing. Two data distribution scenarios were set up: Independent and Identically Distributed (IID) and Non-Independent and Identically Distributed (Non-IID). The experimental results show that in the IID scenario, the FedAcc algorithm achieves higher accuracy on all datasets compared to FedAvg. In the Non-IID scenario, FedAcc performs better in linear regression prediction and color image classification, particularly on the CIFAR-10 dataset, where the accuracy of FedAcc is 35% higher than that of FedAvg. Through experimental analysis, it was found that when there is a certain difference in client accuracy, the FedAcc algorithm performs better than FedAvg. In practical applications, there are usually differences in client accuracy, so FedAcc is more practical than FedAvg.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Visual Semantic Segmentation and Localization for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Addressing the issue of information disparity and intercommunication between visual localization and semantic segmentation, this paper designs an indoor localization system based on the fusion of semantic segmentation and visual localization, mainly applied to indoor localization and environment analysis scenarios. The system acquires images through a monocular camera, utilizes attention convolutional networks in neural architecture search for multi-class pixel segmentation, and calculates the three-dimensional coordinates of target areas through pose estimation and PNP algorithm. Experiments conducted using Nvidia Jetson Nano as the computing platform achieved vehicle tracking and PID motor control. Static environment experiments validated the accuracy of the localization module, with static pixel point localization error generally controlled within 5 cm and vehicle localization error within 7 cm, demonstrating good control of localization errors in both x and y axes. The system exhibits excellent performance in the collaborative ability of semantic segmentation and visual localization, as well as in fusion localization efficiency, providing an effective solution for indoor localization and environment analysis applications.

articleTitle: Inconsistency Evaluation of Lithium-ion Batteries Based on Ledoit-Wolf Covariance Estimation and Mahalanobis Distance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Inconsistencies among lithium-ion batteries can significantly affect the performance and lifespan of battery packs. Variations in manufacturing processes and operating conditions may lead to differences across various parameters, causing overall performance degradation and increasing the risks of overcharging, over-discharging, and thermal runaway. To address these inconsistencies, this study introduces an analytical method based on Mahalanobis distance, enhanced with Ledoit-Wolf covariance estimation. By utilizing an adaptive sliding window in combination with these techniques, the method effectively evaluates variations in internal resistance and identifies inconsistent cells, thereby improving the safety and reliability of lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Short-term Ground Wind Field Forecasting Based on DGCN-2TS
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Wind forecasting plays a crucial role in renewable energy dispatch and extreme weather warnings. However, due to the highly dynamic spatiotemporal characteristics of wind and its rapid variability, accurate wind forecasting has always been a challenging task. In recent years, spatiotemporal graph neural networks have shown potential in integrating temporal information and spatial correlations among stations, providing a new solution for wind forecasting. Nevertheless, existing methods still face two main challenges: a) Predefining the adjacency relationships between stations using a static graph structure fails to effectively capture the dynamic meteorological features that change over time, resulting in the forecasting model's lack of adaptability to complex weather variations. b) The rapid and frequent changes in wind speed and direction make it difficult for traditional models to fit these nonlinear and high-frequency variations, affecting the prediction accuracy. To address these issues, we propose a new spatiotemporal forecasting framework that dynamically combines the spatial correlation structure among stations with the temporal correlations, adaptively generating the adjacency matrix based on meteorological features at each time step to capture the spatiotemporal dynamics of weather conditions. Furthermore, we design a multi-level forecasting model that first predicts meteorological variables with smaller changes and stronger trends, providing foresight information for subsequent wind forecasting and enhancing the model's adaptability to complex meteorological conditions. Experiments conducted on a real dataset from Southwest China demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing models in the wind forecasting task in this region.

articleTitle: Research on PCB Defect Detection Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Due to the small size of defects on printed circuit board (PCB), traditional image processing methods often result in missed detections and high computational costs. This paper proposes a PCB defect detection algorithm based on an improved YOLOv8n model. In the backbone, the C2f module is combined with spatial and channel reconstruction convolution (SCConv) to reduce redundant features and significantly decrease model complexity. In the neck section, a context anchor attention (CAA) mechanism is introduced, which adaptively assigns higher weights to important features, enhancing the model's ability to capture small defects and effectively suppress background noise and irrelevant information. Experimental results on public datasets show that the proposed method achieves significant improvements in precision and mAP@0.5, with increases of 3.0% and 2.2%, respectively, compared to YOLOv8n. The proposed algorithm offers an efficient and practical solution for PCB defect detection, delivering high performance and significant application value.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Greenhouse Temperature Analysis Model for Explanatory and Adaptability
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The greenhouse is a typical microclimate regulation system, where the indoor environment is influenced by numerous external variables and is prone to significant overall fluctuations. Under such circumstances, conventional methods such as fixed temperature thresholds and linear control are inadequate in addressing the energy wastage issues caused by excessive temperature adjustments. This paper investigates a multiparameter analysis method for sunlit greenhouses centered on historical data mining, aiming to provide reasonable temperature predictions for sunlit greenhouses through multiparameter analysis while enhancing model interpretability, thereby laying a foundation for precise regulation of the greenhouse environment. Unlike traditional analysis networks that rely on fixed parameters, this study proposes a framework that combines fuzzy networks with parameter optimization. It utilizes a priori superior architectures to implement fuzzy settings for the CNN network, employs KAN modules to improve interpretability, and conducts global parameter optimization. The training costs are reduced by 9% based on pre-training, while the accuracy increases by 11%. Furthermore, as the number of parameters continues to rise, the training accuracy consistently improves. The model is also capable of fine-tuning optimization under varying weather conditions, thus mitigating the impact of significant fluctuations in the internal environment of the sunlit greenhouse on model accuracy.

articleTitle: Based on Distributed Predictive Formation Control
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Aiming at the control problem of USV formation dragging underpowered objects on water, this paper combines virtual structure and distributed predictive control algorithm. The virtual structure is used to ensure the stability of the formation. Maintaining the desired formation, the collision avoidance and obstacle avoidance functions and terminal constraints are designed under the DMPC framework, and the system stability is analyzed by Lyapunov theory. Simulation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of this method for trajectory tracking and formation maintenance during dragging.

articleTitle: RIS-Assisted Beam Tracking Based on Millimeter Wave V2I Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) brings a new paradigm for the future of mobile communications by building intelligent and controllable wireless environments. A beam tracking algorithm based on RIS selection is proposed for the scenario of multiple RISs assisted millimeter wave vehicle-to-infrastructure communication in this paper. The aim is to maximize the performance of beam tracking while selecting as few RISs as possible to assist communication. The simulation results show that the proposed beam tracking algorithm in this paper has better performance than the traditional beam tracking algorithm based on signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Design of Grinder Fixture Based on Non-Parametric Regression Response Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Taking the mold polishing machine as the research object, in order to improve the dynamic characteristics of the polishing machine, the vibration characteristics are determined through modal and harmonic response analysis. Through topology optimization methods, structural enhancements were made to the fixed seat, improving its contour shape. A multi-objective optimization model was established, sensitivity analysis was performed, and the final optimization design variables were determined. Through automatic space filling sampling complete the experiment points. Non-Parametric Regression model was employed for design optimization, through multi-objective genetic algorithm obtain pareto results. Consequently, the first natural frequency of the fixed seat increased by 12.16%, the maximum deformation decreased by 30.58%, and the mass was reduced by 23.58%, significantly extending its service life. Meanwhile, The amplitude of mold polishing in all directions has also been reduced, resulting in improved dynamic performance of the entire machine.

articleTitle: Incentive Mechanism for Collaborative Sensing in Intelligent Transportation Systems with Mixed Traffic: A Stackelberg Game Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) simultaneously collects driving data of both the Intelligent Connected Ve-hicles (ICVs) and non-ICVs for traffic management in the mixed traffic environment. To this end, a set of ICVs can be scheduled to cooperatively sense a target non-ICV and collect the traffic data to a roadside unit (RSU). An incentive mechanism is necessitated to provide proper incentives for the selfish ICVs. In this paper, we resolve the incentive problem of collaborative sensing in the ITS with the mixed traffic, according to a Stackelberg game approach. We investigate the strategic interactions of the RSU and ICVs in which there exist leader-follower relationships among them. After that, we analyze the Stackelberg equilibrium, and derive the close-form solution of the Stackelberg game. Finally, we provide numerical results to demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed Stackelberg game.

articleTitle: Multi-Task Collaborative Attention-Based Temporal Convolutional Network for Lane Change Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Lane change prediction is critical for autonomous vehicles in mixed traffic, which can improve traffic efficiency and reduce traffic risk. However, accurate lane change prediction is a great challenge due to complex traffic environments and uncertain human intentions. Therefore, a multi-task collaborative attention-based Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) is proposed to establish the connection between environments and intentions. First, an attention-based TCN is proposed to extract the underlying features, where the global attention is used to drive TCN to focus on relevant information of the surrounding environment. Secondly, this paper proposes a multi-task Collaborative method, which predicts both lane change intention and Lane Change Time (LCT). The extensive experimental results on highD dataset show that our method has encouraging accuracy. The proposed method improves the accuracy of lane change intention prediction by 7.69% compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Network Space Asset Data Aggregation and Fusion Technology Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This study proposes a technical solution based on neural network algorithms to address the challenges faced by the aggregation and fusion of asset data in cyberspace. This technology effectively improves data integrity and processing efficiency through deep learning models, which has significant implications for enhancing network security protection. The article first outlines the importance of data aggregation and fusion technology for cyberspace assets, then analyzes the shortcomings of existing technologies and proposes improvement strategies. The study provides a detailed introduction to the proposed neural network-based technology method, including the selection, design, construction, optimization, and training process of neural networks. The experimental section validated the performance of the proposed method on multiple publicly available datasets, and the results showed that it outperformed existing techniques in terms of data integrity, accuracy, and processing efficiency. This study provides a new technical perspective for the field of network security and has important value for information security practice.

articleTitle: Steering and Speed Control Systems Design for Intelligent Car Using Fuzzy PID Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This study focuses on the Bosiklong F car model, designing and manufacturing an intelligent car specifically for dynamic performance testing on an electromagnetic track. To achieve precise control, an integrated electromagnetic board is used to obtain inductance signals, which are then processed using a Kalman filter for noise suppression and data smoothing. A fuzzy PID control algorithm is applied for differential control of the two-wheel vehicle, and comparative experiments are conducted with traditional PID and cascade PID control algorithms. The experimental results show that the fuzzy PID control algorithm outperforms traditional PID and cascade PID algorithms in terms of speed control stability and response time. By effectively handling system nonlinearity, the fuzzy PID control algorithm improves the car's performance on the electromagnetic track, demonstrating its advantages in complex control environments.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method for Tethered Fire Extinguishing Drones Improved by TextCNN and FocalLOSS
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In response to the problems of low efficiency, long time consumption, and unstable detection in current manual fault detection methods for unmanned aerial vehicles, this paper takes tethered firefighting unmanned aerial vehicles as the research object, applies neural networks to fault detection, and proposes and implements an improved unmanned aerial vehicle fault detection method based on TextCNN and FocalLoss. Firstly, based on the principle of threshold comparison and expert experience, define the types of drone faults, determine the characteristics of drone faults according to the fault types, and classify the faults accordingly; Secondly, design and implement a drone log analysis system to preliminarily organize flight logs, visually analyze flight control parameters, retrieve fault data, and construct a fault input dataset; Then, a drone fault detection method based on TextCNN and FocalLoss improvement was proposed to address the characteristics of text data and the problem of imbalanced dataset categories; Finally, experiments were conducted on a real fault flight dataset, demonstrating the effectiveness of the fault detection method.

articleTitle: Contrastive Learning of Sequential Recommendation with Graph Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Sequential recommendation models the dynamic interest changes of users based on their interaction information with items, in order to predict the next interaction item for users. Existing sequential recommendation algorithms are susceptible to data sparsity issues. Contrastive learning sequential recommendation effectively alleviates data sparsity issues through construct samples and data enhancement methods, but it faces data noise problems. In response to the problem of introducing data noise in contrastive learning sequence recommendation, a graph attention mechanism-based contrastive learning sequential recommendation model (GACLRec) is proposed. This model uses the graph attention mechanism to dynamically evaluate and weight the importance of different neighboring nodes, effectively suppressing the interference of noise information and achieving interpretable aggregation of information from neighboring nodes. On this basis, in order to obtain richer node representations, the model further improved the multi-head graph attention mechanism to learn the diverse representations of nodes in multiple latent spaces. By integrating these representations from different spaces, a comprehensive node feature vector is finally obtained, enabling the model to comprehensively learn the actual preferences and behavior patterns of users. Compared with existing excellent algorithms on the real datasets, the beauty and yelp. The experiment proves that the model proposed in this paper has a certain improvement compared to the baseline method on the evaluation metrics HR@N and NDCG@N.

articleTitle: An Improved Genetic Algorithm for the Dubins Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem with Neighborhoods
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the problem of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) engaged in reconnaissance and imaging missions. The aim is to distribute multiple UAVs to diverse target nodes, and ensuring that imaging collection is conducted with high resolution, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Considering the limits of side-looking imaging mode, UAVs must navigate through target area at precise angles, this problem can be described as Dubins Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem with Neighborhoods (DMTSPN). To solve this, we introduce an improved genetic algorithm (IGA). Regenerate the population when facing local optima. Through simulation experiments, we demonstrate our improved genetic algorithm significantly accomplishes the tasks.

articleTitle: Optimization of Liquid Cooling System Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The increase in chip integration and power consumption per unit area significantly raises the surface and internal temperatures of chips. A microchannel heat sink effectively addresses the heat dissipation issues of high-performance chips. Traditional rectangular microchannel heat sinks have a limited convection area and poor heat dissipation performance. Three types of manifold microchannel radiators were designed using SolidWorks software: partially cylindrical, partially square, and fully square. Numerical simulations using Fluent indicate that under a heat flux of 300 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the cylindrical heat sink demonstrates excellent comprehensive heat dissipation performance across different mass flow conditions. It shows higher average convective heat transfer coefficients and Nusselt numbers, with lower pressure drops and friction factors.

articleTitle: Fast coding unit division method based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to reduce the computational complexity of High Efficiency Video Coding(HEVC), this paper introduces a three-branch convolutional neural network(CNN) based on texture, which aims to predict the code unit(CU) partition mode to achieve fast segmentation. Firstly, a three-branch structure is used to adapt to the feature extraction and prediction of CUs in different depths. Secondly, the texture is enhanced by introducing Sobel filter and combining attention mechanism. Thirdly, by fusing the spatial feature information extracted by Haar wavelet decomposition, the ability of model feature extraction is enhanced. The experimental results show that compared with the original HM16.20 encoder, the proposed method reduces the intra coding time by 75.228% on the test sequence.

articleTitle: A White Box Test Method for Smart Energy Meter
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the continuous progress of smart energy meter technology and the increase of functional complexity, the role of software in it is becoming more and more prominent, which also makes its reliability problem become particularly important. Software testing is the key element to ensure the reliability of software. Considering that black-box testing cannot realize branch coverage testing compared with white box testing, this paper proposes an automated white box testing method for smart energy meters based on FLASH and EEPROM read and write backup. The automated white-box test of smart energy meter is accomplished through the construction of related test environment. The test method realizes the full coverage of the software branching path of the smart energy meter by controlling the hardware failure through software. The realization of this test method improves the software reliability of the energy meter without the need to conduct complicated tests on the hardware, which lowers the threshold of the test.

Author Keywords: FLASH and EEPROM read and write

articleTitle: Transformer Based Prediction Model for Carbon Emissions from Cement Clinker Burning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The cement industry, as one of the main sources of carbon emissions in China, accounts for approximately 9.6% of the country's total carbon emissions. Among them, the process of burning cement clinker is the most carbon intensive and concentrated link in the entire cement production process. Therefore, accurately predicting the carbon emissions during the clinker burning process is of great significance for achieving the national dual carbon strategy goals. In terms of time series data processing during the clinker burning process, traditional carbon emission prediction methods cannot effectively capture complex dependency relationships and nonlinear interactions of multidimensional features, and have poor adaptability to different production environments. This article proposes a carbon emission prediction model for cement clinker burning based on Transformer architecture. Firstly, a Transformer model was designed to capture long-term dependencies on multidimensional production data during the clinker burning process. Then, the self attention mechanism is utilized to extract the relationships between various features at different time steps. Finally, verify through actual production data from the cement plant. The experimental results show that the model proposed in this paper has good performance and high practicality.

articleTitle: A novel method for counting wheat ears
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: As an effective method for monitoring and evaluating crop yield, wheat counting using image data plays a vital role in agriculture. However, current methods face significant challenges that hinder their effectiveness. Many existing models require high volumes of data, which can be difficult to obtain and manage, leading to inefficiencies in real-world applications. Additionally, these methods often struggle with inaccurate counting, primarily due to issues such as overlapping wheat ears, occlusion, and varying environmental conditions that complicate image analysis. To address these challenges, this paper presents a wheat counting method based on LC-DeepLab. By integrating the lightweight MobileNet V2 as the backbone, the approach enhances data processing speed and recognition accuracy. The model improves feature extraction through concatenated atrous convolutional layers in the pooled pyramid module. A localization-based counting loss function (LC) is also utilized to further optimize accuracy, ensuring more reliable identification of wheat ears even in complex scenarios. Experimental results on the Global Wheat dataset demonstrate the model's effectiveness, achieving a precision of 92.20%, recall of 92.56%, and mean average precision (mAP) of 90.89%. The proposed method outperforms benchmark models, increasing precision, recall, and mAP by 2.21, 1.74, and 1.93 percentage points, respectively, while meeting real-time detection needs. The LC-DeepLab model exhibits superior robustness in handling complex situations, such as occlusion and overlap, underscoring its potential application in intelligent agriculture.

articleTitle: Enhanced Local Face Feature Encoding via the Petersen Graph Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This study proposes the Weber Petersen Graphic Local Face Feature Pattern (WPLFP), a novel local feature extraction method. WPLFP integrates Weber's Law, utilizing the Weber-Petersen number to encode structural relationships in a 5x5 window. It captures complex inter-pixel patterns through Petersen graph permutations and enriches features with LBP and CS-LBP. A multi-scale model combines vertical (WPLFPv) and horizontal(WPLFPh) histograms. Experiments show that WPLFP outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating its effectiveness in facial feature extraction and recognition. This underscores the benefits of interdisciplinary research and innovative thinking in addressing complex pattern recognition challenges.

articleTitle: Manipulation and Destruction: A Novel Hybrid Poisoning Attack Against Federated Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Due to its ability to protect privacy, federated recommender systems have received widespread attention. Federated recommender systems collaboratively learn recommendation models without sharing user data, effectively preserving privacy. In recent years, researchers have not only focused on improving recommendation efficiency, but also begun to pay attention to security issues of federated recommendations. Since all clients can upload gradients to train the model, adversaries can also exploit this property to carry out poisoning attacks. However, research on attacks against federated recommendation is still incomplete, and attackers need to rely on excessive prior knowledge and manipulate a large number of malicious ellen ts. In addition, existing research only focuses on a single attack method and objective. To reveal the vulnerability of federated recommender systems, we propose a novel hybrid attack called FedRecHP A.It can attack recommender systems without relying on any prior knowledge, achieving the goal of manipulating and destroying recommendation systems. We conducted extensive experiments on two real-world datasets. The results indicate that our proposed method can effectively attack recommender systems, even if we manipulate a small proportion of fake users.

articleTitle: A real-time monitoring method for horizontal traffic in power grid microservice virtual network based on ebpf technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the explosive growth of network traffic, network attack behaviors and anomalous events occur more and more frequently, which adds a lot of difficulties to network management. In order to ensure the security of power grid microservices, a real-time horizontal traffic monitoring method for power grid microservices virtual network based on ebpf technology is proposed. The method writes the corresponding eBPF program according to the monitoring target, and loads the written eBPF program into the kernel using the BPF system call. An eBPF -based container HTTP DDoS detection system is implemented to realize efficient and stable detection and classification of attack traffic. And in the grid microservice architecture, eBPF technology can be used to monitor the horizontal traffic between different microservices in real time, thus improving the security and reliability of the grid system. The experimental results show that by writing the eBPF program and loading it into the kernel, efficient capture and analysis of network packets can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Location privacy protection scheme based on k-anonymity and group signature
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of location-based services, concerns about user privacy leakage are also growing, thus the issue of location privacy protection is receiving increasing attention. A critical method for this is k-anonymity, which obscures individual location data by blending it with fake location data. However, existing k-anonymity schemes lack audit functionality for data usage, which is an essential function for emergency and public safety scenarios requiring prompt location access. We introduce a location privacy protection scheme based on k-anonymity and group signature, it not only enhances the location privacy protection ability, but also makes the contribution to the location tracking in special cases. Through qualitative and quantitative analysis, proposed scheme reflects the effectiveness of anonymous privacy protection and the feasibility of location tracking.

articleTitle: A Certificate Less Group Signature Scheme for Power Internet of Things based on CoSi Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: As power satellites continue to evolve, the security of the large amounts of data transmitted to these satellites has become increasingly important. To ensure the authenticity and integrity of data sources, signature technology emerges as an essential solution. The CoSi (Collective Signature) protocol, known for its ability to facilitate signatures by a diverse, decentralized, and scalable group of witnesses, is particularly apt for group signature applications. In light of this, the paper presents a certificateless group signature scheme that leverages the CoSi protocol. The scheme achieves the collective signature from multiple terminal devices in the form of a group, which improves the efficiency of signature and verification. Additionally, it integrates a certificateless mechanism utilizing elliptic curve cryptography, which not only alleviates the complexities of certificate management but also reduces computational overhead. The security analysis proves that our proposed scheme can resist the selective ciphertext attack, and the performance analysis demonstrates superior computational efficiency in comparison to existing schemes.

articleTitle: Improved AOD-Net Dehazing Algorithm for Target Image
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The target image plays a crucial role in the visual measurement of the object attitude, and its quality directly affects the accuracy of the object positioning. To improve the quality of target images in adverse weather conditions, such as haze, this paper proposes a serial structure combining U-Net and AOD-Net, along with a newly designed adaptive weighted loss function to enhance the traditional dehazing algorithm of AOD-Net. First, the U-Net, as the network's frontend module, performs multi-scale feature extraction and detail enhancement, preserving edge and texture information. Next, AOD-Net applies fast dehazing to the U-Net-processed image, further improving the global clarity of the image. By leveraging the strengths of both networks through this serial structure, the dehazing accuracy of the target image is significantly improved. Finally, based on the importance of the target region and the level of haze, the loss weight is dynamically adjusted, establishing an adaptive weighted loss function that allows the model to focus more on the restoration of key regions. Experimental results show that the improved AOD-Net algorithm exhibits excellent dehazing performance under various haze conditions. Notably, in complex target images, it effectively enhances image quality and recognition accuracy, with the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of the dehazed images improving to 24.61 dB and the structural similarity index (SSIM) increasing to 0.95.

articleTitle: An Improved Target Recognition Algorithm for Urban Management Cases Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To address high computational costs and poor small-target detection in urban management, this paper proposes an efficient target recognition algorithm based on YOLOv8n. The algorithm enhances the backbone with a module based on BiFormer's two-layer routing attention to filter out irrelevant features, improve detail focus, and reduce missed detections. It incorporates a lightweight module with GSConv in the Neck for efficiency and replaces the loss function with SIoU to improve angle matching between predicted and actual boxes. Experimental results show that the improved model significantly outperforms common models like YOLOv5s, Faster R-CNN, and SSD, achieving 93.8% precision and 93.5% mAP@0.5. The algorithm balances high performance with a low parameter count, meeting accuracy and timeliness requirements for urban image target detection.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Morphological Feature Quantization of the Aero-Engine Turbine Disc with Super-Resolution Industrial Computed Laminography
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Industrial computed laminography (ICL) is a three-dimensional (3D) non-destructive imaging method widely used in industrial digital imaging of plate-shell components. However, for imaging aero-engine turbine discs with a sizeable length-width-thickness ratio, there are problems, such as unclear feature details in the laminographic image and the inability to quantify 3D feature distribution. Deep learning is widely used in super-resolution reconstructing image details, which can solve parts of the above problems. Therefore, a 3D feature quantization technology combined with a deep learning network is proposed. By improving the resolution of the laminographic image of the aero-engine turbine disc using a deep learning network, the detailed morphological feature can be obtained and quantitatively analyzed using the 3D nearest neighbor index (NNI) mathematical model to get the multi-scale information of features. This work uses the 3D NNI combined with deep learning to analyze ICL quantitatively reconstructed internal features.

articleTitle: Penguin Island Camera Monitoring System for the Great Wall Station in Antarctica
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The Penguin Island Camera Monitoring System for the Great Wall Station in Antarctica aims to design and implement a penguin island camera monitoring system suitable for the Antarctic environment. The system integrates four parts: power management, communication, control and shooting, and uses a high-performance MSP430 microcontroller to work with a Raspberry Pi in order to realise real-time image acquisition and data transmission. The system uses two SOW photovoltaic panels with 2S0AH gel batteries as the power source to ensure energy self-sufficiency under extreme weather conditions. The combination of Iridium and GPS modules enables efficient remote communication and positioning functions. After the field test of the 40th Antarctic Expedition, the system shows good stability and reliability, successfully collects and transmits high-quality image data, providing effective support for scientific research. The system not only demonstrates the feasibility of long-term monitoring in the polar environment, but also lays the foundation for the further development of related technologies in the future.

articleTitle: Voice Bluetooth Control Car
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of technology, speech recognition and control are becoming increasingly important. The user sends a voice signal, and the system recognizes it, extracts valid commands from the voice, and transmits the commands to the car via Bluetooth. After recognizing the command, the car completes functions such as starting, forward, backward, left turn, right turn, acceleration, deceleration, stop, turning on lights, turning off lights, and automatic obstacle avoidance. The system can also pair with the Bluetooth on the car through a mobile phone and Bluetooth to control the car. For the convenience of information display, the car is equipped with LCD 12864 and ultrasonic distance sensor, which can avoid obstacles during movement. This system has a good reference value for the development of smart homes, industrial automation, robot assisted rescue, etc.

articleTitle: A certificateless signature scheme for power Internet of Things based on Geohash
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the relentless advancement of satellite communication technologies, the penetration of the power Internet of Things has significantly deepened. As the important energy data, the power data uploaded to the satellite usually needs encryption measures to ensure its security and controllability. Certificateless encryption emerges as a prevalent choice in this regard, yet the existing schemes fall short in authenticating the genuineness of terminal devices or users. To address the limitation, a certificateless signature scheme for power Internet of Things based on Geohash is introduced. In the proposed scheme, the key generation center is capable of verifying the authenticity of a terminal device by utilizing the Geohash value associated with the device's geographical location.
